description: This file defines the TestClusterHostFactory class within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace, responsible for creating and configuring silo and cluster client hosts for testing purposes. It includes methods for building host configurations, serializing/deserializing configurations, and setting up services, including logging and system targets.

classes.name: TestClusterHostFactory
classes.description: A utility class for creating and configuring Orleans test silo hosts and cluster clients.

methods.name: CreateSiloHost
methods.description: Creates and configures a new Orleans silo host for testing based on the provided hostname and configuration.

methods.name: CreateClusterClient
methods.description: Creates and configures an Orleans cluster client host.

methods.name: SerializeConfiguration
methods.description: Converts an IConfiguration object into a JSON string for serialization.

methods.name: DeserializeConfiguration
methods.description: Reconstructs an IConfiguration object from a serialized JSON string.
